## Summary

What does this change, and why?

## Gates

All four must pass locally before requesting review:

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything that needs context: known limitations, deliberate trade-offs,
follow-up work intentionally left out of scope.
